protocol.scope: User-authorized physical PREM waveform/energy convergence, explicit DC policy, and matched all-component DSpec/YSpec profiling.

physical.frequency_filter: unity below8mHz; cosine transition8–10mHz; zero at/above10mHz
physical.window: Hann support1000–1200s; sqrt(window) passed to linear P map so squared energy has one Hann factor

physical_degree_scale_only.caveat: Dimensional scale, not a converged Lmax or a fixed pass criterion.

convergence_gates.policy: Fixed gates; retain failures and distinguish refinement differences from convergence proof.

protocol.kernel_policy: Resolve waveform/energy first. Use complete2L angular bandwidth, native SEM radial sides, account explicitly for sampled radial domain and source/receiver singular regions. Assess memory before scheduling.
protocol.numerical_review: Luna High implementation, fresh Luna High review, short Sol High review; additional Sol mathematical review when necessary.
protocol.production_policy: Read-only production; isolated diagnostic adapters and instrumentation here; no commit/push.

dc_policy.target: Explicit bin0 at omega=-i*epsilon; use real DC component for real inverse FFT; record imaginary residual before projection.
dc_policy.inband: k with k*df<0.01 Hz; first above-band guard may be solved but has zero filter and adjoint weight.
dc_policy.diagnostic: Run explicit DC include/exclude comparison; excludingDC is a different observable.

processing_policy.band_operator: 8-10mHz cosine taper sampled on damped-contour bins, before inverse FFT and undo damping. This defines the chosen processing; not a sharp filter of the undamped real-frequency spectrum.
processing_policy.padding: Keep dt,epsilon fixed; vary qex/N independently (1024 to2048 to4096 as needed).
processing_policy.damping_sensitivity: Changingepsilon changes this contour-filtered observable and must be labelled separately from padding convergence.
processing_policy.source: Step moment tensor with1/(i*omega), fullgravity, attenuationoff.
processing_policy.units: Windowed displacement energy in m^2 s; not mechanical energy in joules.

interpretation: Completed runs only. Accuracy runs used distinct CPUs concurrently and are not controlled speed comparisons. No full high-degree global kernel is yet materialized.
